baseline.note: no baseline exists before the first window; prepare captures the within-window baseline and runtime compares against it

engine.note: the VM alias comes from the GO receipt's vm-alias line; the VM must be healthy and its Vault drive attached before the window
engine.runtime: Docker Engine on the Parallels Ubuntu VM

fixtures.note: the refusal cells run the host binary against this host-side fixture; the guest build and identity containers live in the VM under vm_build_dir and the VM's Docker store

images.note: the guest binary builds natively in the VM with the VM's own toolchain (recorded per the Vault-backed Linux proof build rules); the identity container uses an image resident in the VM's Docker store, pinned by prepare; an absent image stops the packet and its pull is named in the GO request, never performed unasked

synthetic.note: no disposable build container on this backend: the toolchain builds natively in the VM
